page.overview:
What is Hypernova?

The Hypernova was the starship of Balada the Hutt. It floated over the Grand Arena on Vespaara.

Hypernova first appeared in the video game Star Wars: Hunters, However, the ship was unnamed until update 0.18.0, through the Arena Pass as one of the rewards available.
